name: Sippin' Safari
description: When Beachbum Berry’s Sippin’ Safari was first published in 2007, it ignited a global Tiki drink revival by revealing 69 top-secret recipes of Tiki’s midcentury golden age, and the stories of the people behind them. Recipe refs in this source cite the original 2007 edition pagination; the 2017 10th-anniversary expanded edition adds 14 more vintage recipes and 10 from the modern Tiki revival, with different pagination.
